crossRefs.note: Yes, my own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, who ate bread with me, has lifted up his heel against me.
But behold, the hand of him who betrays me is with me on the table.
I don’t speak concerning all of you. I know whom I have chosen. But that the Scripture may be fulfilled, ‘He who eats…
Jesus therefore answered, “It is he to whom I will give this piece of bread when I have dipped it.” So when he had…

parallels.note: He answered them, “It is one of the twelve, he who dips with me in the dish.

translations.web: He answered, “He who dipped his hand with me in the dish will betray me.
translations.bsb: Jesus answered, “The one who has dipped his hand into the bowl with Me will betray Me.
translations.kjv: And he answered and said, He that dippeth his hand with me in the dish, the same shall betray me.
translations.asv: And he answered and said, He that dipped his hand with me in the dish, the same shall betray me.
